brief.objective: Get the Bandit inside 5 m of the Lady before t=240 s, or as close as possible, while keeping the Guard well away. A Guard pass closer than about 100 m costs as much as missing the Lady by 100 m, and a Guard capture at 5 m is a catastrophic loss.
brief.approach: Outrun the Guard rather than out-wait it. Its closing speed is capped near 12 m/s, so build along-track speed early toward about 18-20 m/s and offset radially by 250-350 m so the head-on pass happens with lateral clearance. Choose the offset side that lets orbital drift help (radial-in drifts forward relative to the Lady), and use EVADE_GUARD only when the Guard intrudes on the keepout. After the pass, the Guard can only trail at about 12 m/s, so keep the speed lead with APPROACH_LADY along the glide slope, then brake progressively to a slow final approach on the Lady. Do not stop for BRAKE or HOLD_STANDOFF while the Guard is closing. Use COAST whenever speed and geometry are already good, to save fuel for the terminal braking (about 20 m/s needed) and any late evasion.
phases: T0-20s SPRINT_AND_OFFSET: thrust forward toward the Lady at full along-track authority while building a 250-350 m radial offset (GO_TO_WAYPOINT around [-300, -900, 0] or the mirror side); target 15-20 m/s closing.
PASS_GUARD: hold the offset and closing speed through the Guard's crossing. Trigger EVADE_GUARD if the Guard is predicted inside 250 m; never reverse toward the Bandit's start.

RUN_IN: once the Guard is behind and opening or slower, return to the Lady's track with APPROACH_LADY capped at 20 m/s and COAST when on profile. Watch Guard range rate, and re-evade if the Guard comes within 250 m.
TERMINAL: begin braking about 300 m out on the glide slope, finishing at 2 m/s or less inside 30 m, then close to under 5 m. If time is short, accept a higher terminal speed rather than finish short.
CONTINGENCY: if fuel falls below the reserve, or the Guard sits between Bandit and Lady inside 400 m, favour EVADE_GUARD/COAST to protect Guard distance, then take whatever Lady approach remains.

goal.rationale: Begin the sprint by routing the Bandit to a 300 m radial offset waypoint on the Guard's near side, keeping the Guard well clear while building closing speed toward the Lady.
